content: IETF RFC 8785 defines deterministic JSON serialization and RFC 4180 describes common CSV structure. Stable serialization can reduce formatting-only diffs but does not validate financial values or justify rounding; retain full calculation precision and review semantic value changes. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785.html https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4180.html
